title: Common-stage and heart equivalences for cyclic sheets
statement: Fix the data of [def-zl-constant-extension-sheet-heart-data], including l$\ne$p, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of Q_l, G : ZlSheetGeometry D m hm X_0, and the coefficient clauses ZlSheetCoefficientClauses D m hm X_0 l hl of [lem-zl-constant-extension-sheet-coefficient-equivalences]. There exists S : ZlSheetCommonClauses D m hm X_0 l hl $\Omega$ G: the actual common-stage product and full-heart equivalences detecting standard halves, cohomology comparison, identity-normalized stage comparisons, exact Frobenius equivalence on the heart, and exact clopen-inclusion/coordinate factorizations with ambient and coefficient-stage coordinate equivalences. This conclusion contains no Weil-equivariant category or cyclic fixed-pair equivalence.

proof.text: Assume the finite/integral/rational sheet clauses of [lem-zl-constant-extension-sheet-coefficient-equivalences]. Represent the finite tuple of component objects and arrows at one coefficient stage. Use the rational inverse product functor and its scalar-normalized unit and counit to descend the equivalence to common stages. Both standard halves are detected componentwise after extending all finitely many witnesses to one field. Restrict to the full hearts. Use the literal stage comparison, whose components are identities, to retain stage_normalization. The cohomology comparison descends from the stagewise one.

Use [lem-pod-isomorphism-field-transport] for the geometric Frobenius, each sheet coordinate and their inverses. This gives the Frobenius heart equivalence and the coordinate equivalences, with exactness because they are equivalences. Restriction along each clopen inclusion is exact component restriction. The geometric factorization and the specified integral compositor identify the composite heart functor with the product-heart projection. Its scalar law persists after rationalization, giving all coordinate_factors with the inherited residue units.
